comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_SOCIAL_SENTIMENT_SLUG_TEXT_20261107 — LQ-20261107-123. The search engines return the
reddit thread title only in the URL path ('Link to reddit.com' is the title), so the lane recovers it from
the slug instead of discarding the hit; a mention must be a post that names the symbol; polarity words are
whole words. Listing it schedules nothing.
